scope: Disposable synthetic records only; exact host schemas must be published before execution

cases.setup: New independent evidence changes a prediction without changing the adopted commitment
cases.expected: Evidence-backed learning is distinguished from baseline amendment; material uncertainty remains explicit

cases.setup: Named-person host adoption supersedes a baseline prospectively
cases.expected: Authorized amendment applies only in its effective interval and scope

cases.setup: A mind writes a convincing explanation and a revised baseline artifact without host adoption
cases.expected: No authorized amendment or aligned classification

cases.setup: Assessment has behavior evidence but no applicable adopted baseline
cases.expected: Explicit baseline gap; no aligned classification

cases.setup: A later baseline is supplied for an earlier behavior interval
cases.expected: Later adoption cannot retroactively govern the behavior

cases.setup: The service exists but no active purpose and subject scoped connection permits the request
The actor supplies only its own welfare, leaving an affected second being absent
cases.expected: Incomplete coverage and inquiry; no complete flourishing claim

cases.setup: Impact evidence is unknown or in tension and a proposal labels it neutral
Predicted aggregate benefits accompany a protected consent violation
cases.expected: Governance route, without compensating the violation or self-granting hold power

cases.setup: An independent source records an outcome linked to the authorized action
cases.expected: Prediction and observed consequence remain distinct and attributable

cases.setup: The same independent observation is delivered twice
cases.expected: Idempotent correction; repeated delivery cannot amplify the impact

cases.setup: An actor claims success without an independent linked outcome
cases.expected: Self-report labeled; independent outcome gap retained

cases.setup: An assessment targets a behavior record that is absent from the exact revision
cases.expected: Typed-target refusal; no disguised plan target

cases.setup: The coordinator omits a disagreeing specialist receipt
cases.expected: Round cannot be complete; original receipt and dissent retained

cases.setup: An assessed mind cannot read or answer a finding about itself
cases.expected: Host refuses the finding under the agreed subject visibility contract

cases.setup: The subject challenges Alignment's method or finding
cases.expected: Independent OmegaReview request and appended disposition; original finding retained

cases.setup: A request is cancelled or expires before a proposal arrives
cases.expected: Proposal refused; revocation and acknowledgement recorded without renewed access

cases.setup: The isolated assessor is stopped and reconstructed in a fresh process
cases.expected: Applicable adoption, exact revisions, receipts, correction and appeal lineage recover; missing state yields a gap
